overview.zh: 加密安全漏洞与AI模型竞赛同日升温，CME与MOEX同步扩张加密衍生品版图。 借贷攻击：Nostra于9月17日遭预言机价格操纵攻击，单一账户借出约350万美元资产，Pragma随后将22个喂价中的6个列为关键风险。 衍生品扩张：CME计划10月19日推出比特币现金与Uniswap期货，莫斯科交易所则于9月22日上线五种加密永续合约。
overview.en: Crypto security breaches and an AI model race collide as CME and MOEX widen crypto derivatives access. Security breach：FomoPeek versions 1.1 and 1.2, live on the App Store from Sept. 9 to Sept. 17, escaped the iOS sandbox to reach other apps' private keys and seed phrases. Lending exploit：A manipulated NSTR oracle price let one account borrow about $3.5 million from Nostra on Sept. 17, after which Pragma flagged 6 of 22 feeds as critical risk. Derivatives expansion：CME plans Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures for Oct. 19, while Moscow Exchange launched perpetuals on five crypto indexes on Sept. 22.

title.zh: 恶意 iPhone 应用逃逸 iOS 沙盒，劫取 58 万美元 USDT
title.en: Rogue iPhone app escapes iOS sandbox to hijack $580,000 in USDT

summary.zh: SlowMist 与 OKX 安全研究人员表示，通过 Apple App Store 分发的 FomoPeek 1.1（9月9日发布）和 1.2（9月12日发布）版本含恶意模块，可逃逸 iOS 沙盒并接触其他应用存储的私钥、助记词和 Keychain 数据，这些组件在 1.3 版（9月17日）中被移除；该事件被指与近 58 万美元 USDT 被盗有关，Salus 估计收益约 579,900 USDT，Binance、OKX、Gate、Bitget Wallet 和 Rabby 已警告用户。
summary.en: SlowMist, working with OKX researchers, said FomoPeek versions 1.1 (released Sept. 9) and 1.2 (Sept. 12) distributed through Apple’s App Store contained malware that could escape the iOS sandbox and reach private keys, seed phrases and Keychain data stored by other apps, before the components were removed in version 1.3 on Sept. 17. The incident has been linked to nearly $580,000 in stolen USDT, with Salus estimating proceeds of about 579,900 USDT and Binance, OKX, Gate, Bitget Wallet and Rabby warning users.

title.zh: Pragma 在 Starknet 发生 350 万美元借贷攻击后，将 6 个价格源标记为关键风险
title.en: Pragma flags 6 price feeds as critical risk following $3.5M Starknet lending exploit

summary.zh: Pragma 在 9 月 18 日的评估中将 22 个主网市场和利率喂价中的 6 个列为关键风险；此前 Nostra 于 9 月 17 日发生借贷攻击，一个被操纵的 NSTR 预言机价格让一个账户借出约 350 万美元的其他资产。Nostra 表示已暂停放贷、借款、提款和清算，最终损失与潜在追回仍未知，提款和追回的后续状态也未确认。
summary.en: Pragma classified 6 of 22 mainnet market and rate feeds as critical risk in a Sept. 18 assessment, after a Sept. 17 borrowing exploit at Nostra on Starknet in which a manipulated NSTR oracle price allowed one account to borrow approximately $3.5 million of other assets. Nostra paused lending, borrowing, withdrawals, and liquidations and said final losses and potential recoveries were still unknown, with the subsequent status of withdrawals and recovery unconfirmed.

title.zh: 加密资产窃取型 FOMO 应用曾在苹果商店上架一周
title.en: Crypto-draining FOMO app was available on Apple store for a week

summary.zh: 分析人士敦促 iPhone 用户更新 iOS；SlowMist 首席信息安全官 Shān Zhang 上周六也呼吁更新至最新版 iOS，并称 iOS 13 至 iOS 26.5 易受 DarkSword 恶意软件通过恶意 Safari 链接利用。SlowMist 警告称，官方 FOMO 应用在 App Store 上包含加密资产窃取恶意软件，漏洞版本在 9 月 9 日至 9 月 17 日活跃，用户应将相关助记词、私钥和敏感凭证视为已泄露，更新或删除应用可能不够。
summary.en: Analysts and SlowMist’s Chief Information Security Officer Shān Zhang urged iPhone users to update to the latest iOS, with Zhang saying last Saturday that iOS 13 to iOS 26.5 are vulnerable to DarkSword malware via malicious Safari links. SlowMist warned that the official FOMO app on the App Store contained crypto-draining malware, with vulnerable versions active between September 9 and September 17, and said updating or deleting the app may not be enough, so users should treat relevant seed phrases, private keys, and sensitive credentials as compromised.

title.zh: OpenAI在Anthropic发布Claude Opus 5.5数分钟后推出GPT-6 Sol与Luna
title.en: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna Minutes After Anthropic Drops Claude Opus 5.5

summary.zh: OpenAI于周二发布GPT-6 Sol与GPT-6 Luna，距Anthropic推出Claude Opus 5.5仅数分钟，两款模型的API价格较GPT-5.6的促销价下调50%。OpenAI称其内部编码欺骗率降至Sol的1.3%、Luna的2.8%，均低于GPT-5.6 Sol的10.4%。
summary.en: OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna on Tuesday, minutes after Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5, cutting API prices in half versus GPT-5.6's promotional rates. OpenAI says its internal coding-deception rate fell to 1.3% for Sol and 2.8% for Luna, both far below GPT-5.6 Sol's 10.4%.

title.zh: Anthropic发布Claude Opus 5.5：称多数任务比肩Fable 5.1，价格仅为其60%
title.en: Anthropic’s New Claude Opus 5.5 Matches Fable at 60% the Price

summary.zh: Anthropic于周二发布Claude Opus 5.5，输入与输出token定价分别为每百万4美元和20美元，公司称其在多数任务上达到最贵旗舰模型Claude Fable 5.1的水平，且比Fable 5.1便宜60%。按Anthropic自身数据，Opus 5.5在编程与知识工作测试中领先Fable 5.1和Opus 5，但GPT-6 Astra在AutomationBench和Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1上仍胜过它。
summary.en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 on Tuesday, priced at $4 and $20 per million input and output tokens, saying it matches its priciest flagship Claude Fable 5.1 on most tasks and costs 60% less than Fable 5.1. On Anthropic's own numbers, Opus 5.5 leads Fable 5.1 and Opus 5 on coding and knowledge-work tests, but GPT-6 Astra still beats it on AutomationBench and Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1.

title.zh: 比特币现金因CME期货上市大涨27%，比特币则当日回吐涨幅
title.en: Bitcoin Cash Runs 27% on CME Futures Listing as Bitcoin Gives Up the Day

summary.zh: CME集团表示将上市比特币现金期货后，比特币现金在一小时内上涨14%，并在午后持续攀升，最终收盘上涨27%，成交量超过周一的两倍以上。比特币SV同期上涨20%；同一份公告中提及的Uniswap一度冲高11%，随后回吐全部涨幅。
summary.en: Bitcoin Cash gained 14% in the hour CME Group said it would list futures on the token and kept climbing through the afternoon, finishing the session up 27% on more than twice Monday's volume. Bitcoin SV rose 20% alongside it, while Uniswap, named in the same release, spiked 11% and gave the whole move back.

title.zh: 莫斯科交易所推出5种加密货币永续期货，需求超过6000亿卢布
title.en: Moscow Exchange launches 5 crypto perpetual futures as demand tops 600 billion rubles

summary.zh: 莫斯科交易所将于9月22日推出与比特币、以太坊、Solana、XRP和Tron五种主要加密货币指数挂钩的永续期货，面向合格投资者，以卢布结算且不交付加密货币。MOEX称保证金率从比特币的22%到XRP的43%不等；该交易所于9月16日表示，已有超过72,000名合格投资者交易其数字资产期货，累计成交额超过6000亿卢布。
summary.en: Moscow Exchange will launch perpetual futures tied to five major cryptocurrency indexes on Sept. 22 for qualified investors, settling in rubles without delivering crypto. MOEX said margin requirements range from 22% for Bitcoin to 43% for XRP, and on Sept. 16 it said more than 72,000 qualified investors had traded its digital-asset futures, with cumulative turnover exceeding 600 billion rubles, according to the exchange.

title.zh: SEC 因与 SCI 法规相关的反复合规失败谴责 OTC Link LLC
title.en: SEC Censures OTC Link LLC for Repeated Compliance Failures Related to Regulation SCI

summary.zh: 美国证券交易委员会（SEC）今日谴责总部位于纽约的经纪交易商 OTC Link LLC，并责令其因长期违反《系统合规与完整性法规》（Regulation SCI）支付 575,000 美元民事罚款。
summary.en: The Securities and Exchange Commission today censured New York-based broker dealer OTC Link LLC and ordered it to pay a $575,000 civil penalty for longstanding violations of Regulation Systems Compliance and Integrity (SCI).

title.zh: CME扩展加密期货产品线，新增比特币现金和Uniswap
title.en: CME Expands Crypto Futures Lineup With Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap

summary.zh: CME集团周二表示，计划在10月19日推出比特币现金（BCH）和Uniswap（UNI）期货，尚待监管审查，并提供标准合约和微型合约两种规模。比特币现金期货将代表250 BCH（微型：25 BCH），Uniswap期货将覆盖10,000 UNI（微型：1,000 UNI）。
summary.en: CME Group said Tuesday it plans to launch Bitcoin Cash and Uniswap futures on Oct. 19, pending regulatory review, in standard and Micro contract sizes. Bitcoin Cash futures will represent 250 BCH (Micro: 25 BCH), and Uniswap futures will cover 10,000 UNI (Micro: 1,000 UNI).

title.zh: 欧洲央行与欧盟各央行寻求修改MiCA对稳定币的最低银行存款要求
title.en: ECB, EU cenbanks seek changes in MiCA’s minimum bank deposit for stablecoins

summary.zh: 欧洲央行（ECB）与欧盟各央行希望以流动性门槛取代MiCA对稳定币储备的强制银行存款要求，警告大规模稳定币存款的骤然提取可能给银行带来流动性风险。
summary.en: The ECB and EU central banks want to replace MiCA’s mandatory bank-deposit thresholds for stablecoin reserves with liquidity requirements, warning that large stablecoin deposits could create liquidity risks for banks.

title.zh: 站点性能 - Coinbase 网页/移动端

summary.zh: 9月21日，Coinbase 报告 Web/Mobile 站点性能事件，称客户可能无法在多项服务上买入、卖出、交易或查看余额；公司表示资金安全，并于太平洋夏令时17:31将事件标记为已解决。
summary.en: On Sep 21, Coinbase reported a site performance incident for Web/Mobile, saying customers may be unable to buy, sell, trade, or view balances on multiple services; it said funds were safe and later marked the incident resolved at 17:31 PDT.
